title: dev-team model catalogue
description: The list of models the engine can route to. The shipped starting list is engine/data/catalogue.seed.json; discovery adds models found on this machine.

dev-team.description: Ownership marker; proves the engine's own file.

description.description: What this file is and where its facts come from.

models.description: One entry per model (or per role-level placeholder for a provider not yet tried).

provider.description: The AI system: claude, codex, gemini, copilot, deepseek, kimi, grok, ollama.

id.description: The name used to refer to this entry. Exact dated model ids are never stored in the seed.

alias.description: The short name a tool accepts when starting a worker, and the name settings (ask-first, pin) use.

tier.description: Strength: 1 utility, 2 engineer, 3 architect, 4 principal. Tier 4 is never the default.

tierSource.description: Where the tier came from: the routing reference, the owner, a placeholder, or a guess from the model's name.

local.description: True for a model running on this machine. Local models are free and never need approval.

costBand.description: A rough relative price from 0 (free) to 10. Not a bill.

priced.description: False when no price is known. An unpriced model counts as ask-first while 'unpriced' is on that list.

roles.description: Jobs this model may do: scout, builder, architect, reviewer, mechanical, documentarian.

classes.description: Named groups the ask-first list can refer to, such as fable or openai-top.

verified.description: True only when this provider has been tried against a real account.

source.description: seed (shipped) or discovered (found on this machine).
